acceptance_criteria: Provider can be selected through the existing factory
Provider failure returns the documented fallback behavior

principles.kiss: Add one provider implementation and existing factory wiring only.
principles.yagni: Do not introduce a generic provider framework.
principles.single_source_of_truth: Provider metadata remains in the existing provider configuration path.
principles.contracts: Preserve the denoiser interface and packet behavior.
principles.fail_safe: Return the existing fallback error path and clean up provider resources.
principles.security: Do not log credentials or audio payloads.
principles.observability: Use existing provider failure logging and metrics.
principles.reversibility: Removal of factory registration disables the provider without data migration.
